title: Ines and the Archive
author: Rosalind Oyelaran
blurb: Odile Iversen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
